show.description:
World’s most powerful security genius suriya… living as a simple guard.
He hides his identity to protect his best friend’s sister Anika from a dangerous family.
But fate twists everything when he’s forced to marry her without revealing the truth.
Now trapped in a risky secret, how long can he protect her before it all falls apart?
